items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Remember Harrison Bones? Oh yeah. Well, he was playing trumpet in the band.

ctx.x: Do you know? E E E F F I E. Two F. E E F F I E. Okay. Effie Jones. Uh huh. Well, at the time they had Harrison Bones. Remember Harrison Bones? Oh yeah. Well, he was playing trumpet in the band. Um huh. Had a fella called Harrison, or no, a fella called Pierre, Pierre Anderson. He was playing trumpet. You know what? You see? Playing trumpet. I can't call all the men's names in the band. Man, they had some brothers down there. Right?

They had some brothers down there. I can't think of their names and they all played music. Who that? Some brothers down there in Magnolia. I can't think of their names. Mm hmm. Harrison Bones told me about them. Let me see.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Pierre, Harrison Bones, Sonny Henry, all them fellas. Good musicians.

ctx.x: You remember a lot of things, too.

Yeah. Sure. Who is this Joe Granson or something like that? Joe Granson? Yeah, Granson. Oh, he was the musician for my home, you see? He used to be a trombone player, baritone player. Yeah, he's good trombone player and baritone player, too. He's a good musician. Well, that's one of the fellas Old Man Humphrey taught. Jim Humphrey. Poise Humphrey's granddaddy taught. That's one of the fellas he taught, you see? Jim Humphrey. Old Man Humphrey, he turned out some good musicians from that low course. Good musicians.…
